div.div: 3 جاودهُ He vied with him, or contended with him for superiority, in liberality, bounty, munificence, or generosity. (S, TA.) You say, جاودهُ ↓ فَجَادَهُ He vied with him, or contended &c., in liberality, &c., and overcame him therein. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
